c1.note: NBCUniversal's own About page states it is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation.

c3.note: The About page lists these brands verbatim as ones it owns and operates.

c4.note: The About page names Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation and Focus Features as its film and television studios.

c5.note: The About and Brands pages say Universal Studio Group houses four television studios.

c6.note: The About page and the Comcast 10-K both cover Universal Orlando with Epic Universe and Universal Studios Hollywood.

c9.note: The Brands page text matches the claim on Illumination verbatim.

c11.note: Hayu appears on the Brands page.

c12.note: NBCUniversal Local appears on the Brands page.

c13.note: Universal Products & Experiences appears on the Brands page.

c14.note: Universal Studio Group is described as the umbrella for NBCUniversal's four TV studios.

c15.note: The site footer lists the four divisions: Destinations & Experiences, Media, NBC News Group and Studios.

c16.note: Brands listed match the NBCUniversal Wikipedia infobox and about page; NBCSN was relaunched in 2025 and is retained by NBCU.

c17.note: Homepage and brands page list these brands, including Illumination, Hayu and Local stations.

c18.note: Brands page lists Universal Pictures Content Group and UPHE; the 10-K lists Illumination, DreamWorks and Focus.

c19.note: The Universal Studio Group description names Universal Television, UCP, Universal Television Alternative Studio (and Universal International Studios).

c20.note: Parks are listed; the 10-K confirms Horror Unleashed, Kids Resort and the UK resort (planned, not yet open).

c21.note: Working Title, UIP and Blumhouse minority stake are supported; Amblin is a library/minority-stake relationship.

c22.note: Universal Global Television lists Carnival Films, Heyday (JV), Lark Productions and NBCUniversal Formats.

c23.note: Telemundo Enterprises lists Telemundo, Telemundo Studios and Universo.

c24.note: 13th Street and Diva are listed as defunct, so naming them as current networks is wrong; the 10-K names Studio Universal, Telemundo International and Universal TV.

c25.note: Peacock, NBC News, NBC Local Stations and Telemundo are owned; the Telemundo Station Group is a standard unit.

c27.note: The Comcast release states the separation was effective at 11:59 p.m. ET on Jan 2, 2026.

c28.note: The release lists these Versant brands; the 10-K confirms they were separated from Comcast.

c31.note: Comcast filings say Versant comprises digital platforms GolfNow, Fandango, Rotten Tomatoes and SportsEngine; they are no longer NBCU subsidiaries.

c32.note: Versant spin-off completed Jan 2, 2026, so those networks and Fandango left NBCU; the claim's hedge is unneeded since the 10-K confirms it.

c33.note: Announced June 29, 2026, completion expected summer 2027 (about one year).

c36.note: NBCU says its portfolio will include Sky after the spin-off; Sky is currently a Comcast business outside NBCU. The 10-K segment wording is more ambiguous, so this is medium confidence.

c38.note: Matches NBCU's own description of the post-spin company.

c40.note: The 10-K describes Sky Sports networks in the UK and Italy within the Media segment. Comcast's segments are not literally named 'NBCUniversal Media'.

c41.note: The Studios segment includes Sky Studios alongside Universal studios. Medium confidence, as the segment is not literally labelled 'NBCUniversal Studios'.

c42.note: NBCUniversal Media, LLC is wholly owned by NBCUniversal, LLC per Comcast's filings. No saved passage states it directly; this rests on my background knowledge.

c43.note: The 10-K includes Exhibit 21 with a list of subsidiaries. The exact filing date of Feb 3, 2026 is not confirmed in the passages.

c44.note: The exhibit lists NBCUniversal International Limited and many other NBCUniversal entities. The other named entities are plausible but not all seen in the excerpts.

c45.note: Exhibit 21 is the list of Comcast subsidiaries, and NBCUniversal Media, LLC is a Comcast consolidated subsidiary (Delaware). Delaware is not seen directly in the excerpts.

c46.note: The Exhibit 21 excerpts show NBCUniversal International Limited and NBCUniversal Entertainment Japan LLC. Related NBCUniversal Digital entities appear, and the other named entities are plausible members of the same alphabetical list, though not all are visible in the excerpts.

c47.note: Peacock TV LLC (DE) and Peacock TV EMEA Limited (UK) appear directly in the Exhibit 21 list.

c48.note: Both DreamWorks Animation L.L.C. and DreamWorks Animation International Services, LLC appear in Exhibit 21.

c49.note: The excerpts show many Universal-named entities, and the named studio entities are standard Comcast subsidiaries, though not each one is visible in the excerpts.

c50.note: Telemundo Media LLC and Telemundo Network Group LLC are shown directly. Bravo Media LLC is a known Comcast subsidiary but is not visible in the excerpts.

c52.note: The NBCUniversal about page describes brands and divisions, while Exhibit 21 lists the separate legal entities, so the brand list is not a list of incorporated subsidiaries.

c26.note: Saved Wikipedia NBCU template confirms an 8% SNY stake and part ownership of MLB Network and NHL Network. A web search found the 5.44% and 15.6% figures on the Wikipedia list of Comcast assets, but no independent source. These are minority stakes rather than subsidiaries.
